friends.duplicateHint.zh-CN: 你们已经有另一个通道。可以忽略这份邀请，或切换到对方的通道；旧文件会保留。
friends.duplicateHint.en-US: You already have another channel. Ignore this invitation or switch to theirs. Existing files will be kept.

friends.switchConfirm.zh-CN: 将这张名片切换到对方邀请的通道？原通道的文件和留言会保留在云盘中，当前名片将只显示新通道的内容。
friends.switchConfirm.en-US: Switch this card to the invited channel? Files and messages in the old channel will remain in Cloud. This card will show the new channel's content.

friends.peerChanged.zh-CN: 这张名片的云盘邮箱与原通道不同。请为新的联系人建立独立通道，原通道不会转交给别人。
friends.peerChanged.en-US: This card's cloud email differs from the original channel. Create a separate channel for the new contact; this channel will not be transferred.

friends.partialCheck.zh-CN: 部分共享库暂时无法检查，已显示其他邀请。稍后会自动重试。
friends.partialCheck.en-US: Some shared libraries could not be checked. Other invitations are shown; unavailable libraries will be retried.

friends.connectCloud.zh-CN: 连接清华云盘后即可检查好友邀请。
friends.connectCloud.en-US: Connect Tsinghua Cloud to check friend invitations.

friends.accountUnknown.zh-CN: 云盘未返回账号邮箱，请重新连接。
friends.accountUnknown.en-US: Cloud did not return your account email. Please reconnect.

friends.invalidInvite.zh-CN: 邀请已失效或不属于当前云盘账号，请刷新后重试。
friends.invalidInvite.en-US: This invitation is unavailable or belongs to another cloud account. Refresh and try again.

friends.personalOnly.zh-CN: 好友通道需要选择个人联系人。
friends.personalOnly.en-US: Select a personal contact to create a friend channel.

friends.needPeerEmail.zh-CN: 请先接收含有对方清华云盘邮箱的名片，不能向自己发起邀请。
friends.needPeerEmail.en-US: First receive a card with your friend's Tsinghua Cloud email. You cannot invite yourself.

friends.ownerOnly.zh-CN: 只有通道创建者可以补发邀请。
friends.ownerOnly.en-US: Only the channel owner can resend its invitation.

friends.readOnlyInvite.zh-CN: 对方只授予了阅读权限，请让对方补发读写邀请后再接入。
friends.readOnlyInvite.en-US: This invitation is read-only. Ask the sender to resend it with read and write access.

friends.alreadyConnected.zh-CN: 你和这位好友已有通道，请从现有名片进入，避免建立重复通道。
friends.alreadyConnected.en-US: You already have a channel with this friend. Open their existing card to avoid duplicate channels.

friends.newInvites.zh-CN: 收到 {count} 个好友通道邀请，点顶栏信封或进入通讯录查看。
friends.newInvites.en-US: {count} friend channel invitations received. Open the envelope in navigation or go to Contacts.

friends.inboxHint.zh-CN: 应用在前台时每 30 秒检查一次，重新打开或回到前台也会检查。无需双方各建一个通道。
friends.inboxHint.en-US: Checked every 30 seconds while the app is visible, and when opened or brought to the foreground. One shared channel connects both of you.

friends.inviteDetail.zh-CN: 邀请你使用同一个共享云盘和好友通道。接入后，对方会看到确认回执。
friends.inviteDetail.en-US: Join the same shared cloud folder and friend channel. The sender will receive an acceptance receipt.

friends.published.zh-CN: 邀请已发布到对方云盘，对方打开 OneTHU 后可发现并接入。
friends.published.en-US: Invitation published to your friend's cloud account. They can discover and join it when they open OneTHU.

friends.legacyChannel.zh-CN: 已有云盘，需补发接入邀请
friends.legacyChannel.en-US: Cloud folder exists · send a join invitation

friends.upgradeLegacy.zh-CN: 将这个旧通道升级为账号邀请？原来的公开分享链接会失效，共享文件和留言会保留。对方可在 OneTHU 内发现并接入。
friends.upgradeLegacy.en-US: Upgrade this channel to an account invitation? Its public link will stop working; files and messages will be kept. Your friend can discover and join it in OneTHU.

friends.legacyLinkUnknown.zh-CN: 无法识别旧分享链接，请先在云盘撤销它，再重试。
friends.legacyLinkUnknown.en-US: The old share link could not be identified. Revoke it in Cloud before retrying.
